summary.name: QuickGif
summary.one_liner: QuickGif is a lightweight macOS menu bar app for searching, copying, and dragging GIFs into other apps.
use_cases: Find and insert a GIF into a chat message
Drag a GIF into Mail or Slack
Quickly search GIFs without leaving the current app
Copy GIFs from the menu bar for reuse
summary.what_it_does: QuickGif opens a GIF picker from the Mac menu bar, activated by the shortcut Command+Option+V by default. You type to search, use the arrow keys to select a GIF, and press Enter to copy it. The page says GIFs can be copied or dragged into any app that supports drag-and-drop or image pasting, such as Messages, Slack, Discord, and Mail. Core features are free, and a Premium version adds favorites, search suggestions, random filenames, and link copying. The shortcut can be changed in Settings.
notable: Menu bar GIF picker opened with Command+Option+V
Copy or drag GIFs into most Mac apps that support drag-and-drop or image pasting
Favorites were migrated from Tenor to Klipy after Tenor's API shutdown
caveats: Premium tier adds favorites, search suggestions, random filenames, and link copying
Only available for macOS; other platforms not planned
Old favorites were lost in the migration from Tenor to Klipy because Tenor is shutting down its API in June 2026
